A0206.title: Enterprise Collaboration Data Loss Prevention
A0206.description: Collects sharing behaviors, outbound traffic, and content characteristics from cloud drives, IM, email, knowledge bases, and collaborative documents; applies sensitive data identification, rule matching, and sharing control policies to detect abnormal outbound activities, and retains outbound audit logs.

references.title: Cloud Controls Matrix - Cloud Security Alliance

A0206.definition: Apply sensitive-data discovery, sharing control, and outbound audit to cloud drives, IM, email, knowledge bases, and collaboration documents.
A0206.limitation: Insiders can bypass sensitive data identification through screenshots, photos, or encrypted compression; end-to-end encrypted communications render content inspection ineffective. Legitimate cross-department collaboration and large file sharing are prone to false positives and collateral damage; overly strict rules may block lawful business sharing.
